propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one ordered rebar OTel span nested under the Agent model-request span via ambient context, with no duplicate wrapping from instrument_all.

Candidate spans must record zero-based order, provider-qualified model identity, outcome from {returned, raised}, and optional provider-reported usage, without changing FallbackModel selection, ProviderSession lifecycle, or RunUsage totals.
The S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade must be legible as a native attempt span raised followed by a prompted attempt span returned, with no change to _pai_structured control flow.
Raised candidate span reasons must be sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic and contain no prompt, response, credential, endpoint, or unsanitized exception body.
Span emission or exporter failures while tracing is enabled must be swallowed at the wrapper boundary, leaving fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception identical to tracing-off.
The base install without tracing extra imports must run with no span dependency error and identical behavior to tracing-disabled mode.
